newsitem.title: FRANCE: United to add 777 to Paris-San Francisco run.
newsitem.headline: United to add 777 to Paris-San Francisco run.

text.p: United Airlines said its decision to introduce a Boeing 777 aircraft on its daily Paris-San Francisco from July 1997, will mean more cargo capacity is available on the route.

"At present, we operate 767-300's between Paris and San Francisco which offer seven to 12 tonnes of cargo capacity per flight depending on the passenger complement. However, with the 777 there would be the guarantee of a regular 15 tonnes of space available per flight," a Paris-based United cargo official told Reuters.
United already operates 777s on daily flights from Paris to Chicago and Washington. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
